title: Checks and events on the same day, and a debit that posts later (review v3 situations 2, 3 and 4, decision H1)
story: Four made-up bank accounts, each opened on Fri 20 Nov 2026 with 300,000, so each situation has its own clean sums. Setup: the person sets up at 10:00 and logs a 7,000 dinner at 19:30 the same day. One check: a check at 09:00 on the 22nd, then a 5,000 lunch logged at 12:00. Two checks: the same, and a second check at 18:00 that shows 290,000. Debit: a 10,000 debit card spend on the 21st that the bank posts on the 24th; a check on the 22nd shows 300,000 because the bank does not show it yet. H1: a check holds the events dated before its day, and those on its day that the app heard of before it (told); a bank line with a posting date counts by that date. Every amount is made up.
